chunks: And Muhammad ibn Hammam ibn Suhayl narrated to us, saying: Abdullah ibn al-Ala' al-Mathari narrated to us, saying: Idris ibn Ziyad al-Kufi narrated to us, saying: One of our sheikhs narrated to us, saying: Al-Mufadhdhal said:

I held your hand as Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) held my hand and said to me: 'O Mufadhdhal! This matter is not merely by saying [it], no, by Allah, until (we) preserve it as Allah has preserved it, honor it as Allah has honored it, and fulfill its due right as Allah has ordered.'

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah, a common title for Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)
key_terms.الْأَمْر: The matter/affair, often referring to the Imamate or the secret of the Prophet's family

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) tell Al-Mufadhdhal about the nature of the 'matter' of the Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Kitab al-Ghayba*, Al-Mufadhdhal ibn Umar reports Imam al-Sadiq’s (peace be upon him) instruction that the 'Amr' (the Imamate or divine authority) transcends mere verbal affirmation, requiring active preservation (*hisan*) and honoring (*tashrif*) akin to how Allah safeguards and elevates it. This highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on the Imamate as a dynamic, divinely protected trust that demands both internal conviction and external manifestation of its rights, linking the spiritual status of the Ahl al-Bayt directly to divine action.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (11) Muhammad bin Hammam bin Suhayl narrated from Abdullah bin al-Ala’ al-Mathari from Idreess bin Ziyad al-Kufi from one of his sheikhs that al-Mufadhdhal had said to him: “I hold your hand as Abu Abdullah (as) has held my hand and said to me: “O Mufadhdhal, this matter is not achieved by saying only. No, by Allah, it is not so until (our companions) preserve it as Allah has preserved it, honor it as Allah has honored it and care for it deservingly as Allah has ordered.”
